name: Eventstream
short_description: A Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence item that connects to event sources, applies transformations such as filters or aggregations, and routes the data to destinations such as an eventhouse.

evidence.quote: An event stream connects to that source.
telemetry directly into a fabric event stream.
Event streams are the pipes that bring data in
